subject: Mid-cycle seats added — billing approach & VAT handling
messages:
From: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@verdanthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Seats increase: +12 mid-billing-cycle — VAT and invoicing?

Hi Ben,

Quick one — we provisioned 12 additional seats for our team effective May 10 to support a short project. Our billing cycle is calendar-month (starts May 1). Can you confirm how Redwood will handle the mid-cycle charge/proration on the May invoice?

Two things to flag:
- We need the invoice to match our PO (PO 1793) for internal approvals.
- We operate in EU and have an EU VAT ID for the holding company; I can share the VAT number if you need it for reverse-charge.

Ideally we want a one-line charge for the prorated seats (or a credit applied to next month) — whichever is standard. Also confirm whether you can send a pro-forma so our finance team can release payment quickly.

Attaching PO for reference (purchase-order-verdant-1793.pdf).

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Morgan
Finance Manager, Verdant Health
ava.morgan@verdanthealth.com
+p: +44 20 7123 4567

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Seats increase: +12 mid-billing-cycle — VAT and invoicing?

Hi Ava — thanks, and great to hear the rollout is underway. Short answer: we can do either an immediate pro-rated invoice for the remainder of May or apply a one-off adjustment on your next invoice; most customers prefer the pro-forma now so AP can pay against the PO.

A few specifics so you have what finance needs:
- Proration method: daily pro-rate based on days remaining in the billing period. For a May 10 effective date (May has 31 days) that leaves 22 days (May 10—31 inclusive).
- Line calculation we will show on the pro-forma: 12 seats x seat_rate ($150/mo) x (22/31). Example math: 12 * $150 = $1,800 monthly; prorate factor 22/31 ≈ 0.7097 → prorated charge ≈ $1,277.45.
- VAT: if you send your EU VAT ID and confirm it’s valid for reverse-charge, we will issue net invoices with the reverse-charge note. Otherwise we’ll apply standard VAT rates based on your billing address.
- Payment terms: net 30 by default; we can do immediate invoice with net 30 to align to your PO.

I’ll loop in Laura (billing) to prepare the pro-forma and Marcus (AM) to confirm acceptance. If you can send the VAT ID and confirm the PO line to reference, we’ll issue the pro-forma today.

Attaching a short amendment stub to capture the seat change for signatures: seat-amendment-stub.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Internal: Verdant — mid-cycle seat add (PO 1793) — billing approach

Laura / Marcus — quick internal note so billing is aligned with Sales intent:
- Customer: Verdant Health (PO 1793) added +12 seats effective 2027-05-10.
- Customer preference: pro-forma now so AP can pay against PO. They will provide EU VAT ID if eligible.

Two options:
A) Immediate pro-forma + invoice for prorated charge (preferred for cash capture).
B) Apply a credit/adjustment on June invoice (simpler ops).

Finance guidance from me: invoice now — the amount is material (~$1.3k net) and we should capture in the month. If they provide a valid VAT ID we will mark as reverse-charge; otherwise include VAT.

Suggested invoice line (invoice item):
- 12 seats — prorated May 10–31 — 22/31 days. Seat list price $150/mo.
- Calculation: 12 * $150 * (22/31) = $1,277.45 (net) — round to 2 decimals.

Laura: can you prepare pro-forma referencing PO 1793 and GL code 4101 (seat revenue)? Marcus: can you confirm with the customer whether they need invoice sent to payments+invoices@verdanthealth.com or to their parent entity?

Thanks — Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Verdant — mid-cycle seat add (PO 1793) — billing approach

Ben — will do. I’ll prepare a pro-forma invoice today and issue a formal invoice once payment is received or per the normal flow (we usually send the formal invoice same day as pro-forma for transparency). Draft details below for internal handoff: 

Pro-forma draft (will be PDF attachment):
- Customer: Verdant Health
- PO: 1793
- Billing contact: payments+invoices@verdanthealth.com
- Description: "12 additional seats — prorated May 10—31 (22/31 days)"
- Unit price: $150.00 / seat / month
- Quantity: 12
- Prorate factor: 22/31 = 0.709677
- Line net: $150 * 12 * 0.709677 = $1,277.45
- Tax: TBD (apply reverse-charge if we receive validated EU VAT ID; otherwise apply 20% VAT assumed for drafts)
- Invoice reference: PF-VERD-20270524-1793
- Payment terms: Net 30

I will set GL 4101 and note internal memo: "apply as one-off mid-cycle prorate; do not change recurring seat count on subscription until amendment accepted."

Attaching pro-forma stub: proforma-invoice-verdant-20270524.pdf

Laura
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

3) Payment terms: Net 30. If AP needs a different cadence let us know and Marcus will coordinate.

Link to the pro-forma and amendment for signature: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/verdant/PO-1793 and DocuSign for the seat amendment: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/verify/verdant-amendment-1793
